# Colin Bamforth

> Author of paramedic thrillers, science-backed stress-management guides and children's books, written by a paramedic with more than 37 years on the front line in New Zealand, Australia and the UK.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://colinbamforth.com/): author profile, current books and book news.

## Books

- Overwhelmed by Stress? series: science-backed stress-management guides.
- Shift-Worker Stress Workbook: a workbook for shift workers, coming soon (see manicmedic.com).
- Paramedic thrillers and children's books: see the homepage for the current list.
